entries.290d6427046f6863: This is a single business related to the development and operation of pay-by-time parking lots. There are no business segments requiring separate disclosure; the business is classified by operating format into "Leased Parking," "Owned Parking" and "Other." Sales results for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥14,091 million for Leased Parking, ¥2,907 million for Owned Parking and ¥631 million for Other. As of September 30, 2025, 2,598 locations with 48,232 parking spaces were in operation.
entries.449c9b6225341fbf: The basic management policy is 'to resolve the shortage of parking in Japan and realize a comfortable car society.' Aiming to supply more parking facilities that carry no cancellation risk or are unlikely to be cancelled, the company is actively investing in owned parking facilities, which provide 'base revenue' less affected by the external environment. Centering on owned parking facilities, the company aims to become the local leader in core cities nationwide and is advancing four 'standardizations': site selection, parking space design, operations and pricing. The company places importance on three indicators: 'base revenue', an indicator that directly shows the profitability of parking facilities, and 'parking space balance'; as a stock-type business model, it has set no specific numerical targets.

entries.8f4749fceeb42845: The company engages in a single business related to the development and operation and management of parking facilities, and revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥17,630 million. Both the number of facilities operated and the number of parking spaces operated, along with the number of new openings of facilities and spaces, reached record highs, and as of September 30, 2025, 2,598 facilities with 48,232 parking spaces were in operation. Revenue by region was ¥7,754 million in the Kanto area, ¥4,224 million in the Kansai area, and ¥5,651 million in other areas. Regarding the market size of the time-based parking industry, the company states that no comprehensive industry association exists and that an accurate figure cannot be calculated.

entries.d350f65b00244d59: Business based on the owned-parking model is offered by almost no other companies in the industry; because there is no cancellation risk arising from landowners' circumstances and no rent is incurred, it serves as 'base revenue' that supports management even in periods when revenue declines due to the external environment. Through acquiring owned parking facilities, the company has strengthened its relationships with real estate companies, including developers, and financial institutions, which has also expanded its information on parking sites. Through the four 'standardizations' of site selection, parking space design, operations and pricing, the company has accumulated know-how in property development and operation and management.
